entities.summary: Cody James Asche is an American former professional baseball player—as third baseman and left fielder—and coach who currently serves as the assistant hitting coach for the Detroit Tigers of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played in MLB for the Philadelphia Phillies and Chicago White Sox.
